questions.question: In SALT, which group is assessed FIRST after global sorting?
options: C. Still casualties / obvious life threats
questions.rationale: Still casualties and obvious life threats are most likely to need LSIs.

questions.question: Which is a SALT lifesaving intervention?
questions.rationale: LSIs: hemorrhage control, airway (± 2 breaths for kids), chest decompression, auto-injector.

questions.question: A breathing patient obeys commands, has a peripheral pulse, no respiratory distress, hemorrhage controlled, and an open femur fracture. SALT category:
questions.rationale: All four YES but injuries aren't minor → Delayed.

questions.question: A breathing patient has no peripheral pulse but is likely to survive with care available. SALT category:
Expectant patients should receive:
options: A. Comfort care and re-triage when resources allow
questions.rationale: Expectant is a resource-based decision; comfort care and re-triage are required.

questions.question: In SALT, an apneic child after airway opening should:
options: C. Receive consideration of 2 rescue breaths
questions.rationale: Children: consider 2 rescue breaths before tagging dead.

questions.question: Which is the BEST place to attach a triage tag?
questions.rationale: Clothing is cut off in treatment; tags on clothing get lost.

questions.question: High over-triage rates in an MCI are associated with:
questions.rationale: Over-triage diverts resources from the truly critical (Frykberg).

questions.question: A patient tagged yellow deteriorates in the treatment area. The correct action:
options: D. Re-triage to red, note the time, and inform the treatment/transport officers
questions.rationale: Update the category and time; communicate the change.

questions.question: Which statement about triage systems is TRUE?
options: A. SALT is only for chemical events
B. START includes an Expectant step
C. SALT includes LSIs and an Expectant category
D. Triage Sieve is only for children
questions.rationale: SALT integrates LSIs and Expectant; START has no Expectant step.
